title: Guide through the Alhambra
text: We went on an express weekend to Granada, and we took a guided tour with Simón. I have not seen a guide who explains things the way he did; he immersed us fully in the history of the Alhambra, he did it in such a way that it was very enjoyable and easy to follow, we did not have the feeling that he was reading us a book. He was attentive at all times to taking photos of us (for the memory) and giving us our time to enjoy every corner, detail, and view. Memory from the 3 madrileñas Natalia, Laura, and Cris
author: F572UXcristinam

title: Mysterious and marvelous Alhambra
text: This was a bucket list item. Absolutely loved the experience. Definitely do a guided tour to understand the history of this fortress. Georgia was an awesome guide. We understood the history, the carvings on the door, architecture and paintings. We booked a morning tour online. It was the least crowded. It was a three hour tour. Its a vast fortress. You enjoy the beautiful gardens, fort, palaces quarters and museums as well. Lookout for hand of Fatima above the gates, the painting of the sultans and key above the gates. The lion courtyard with fountain of lions is the highlight. Love the blues
author: archlav

title: Amazing!
text: I was there 50 years ago and I don't remember the gardens being as stunning!!  Of course I'm sure more has been added over the years but it was amazing to see it all again and refresh my memory on the history and the beautiful architecture!  We were there 4 hrs, some of it on our own time.
author: llergl

title: Creative problem solving at Alhambra
text: Viator and Chase Travel have yet to let me down! Booked these tickets months ago as they sell out fast and thought 9 am admission would work- nope, cruise ship docks at 7:30 and it’s a 2 hr drive from cruise port to Granada and another 20 min taxi ride to Alhambra. Neither Viator nor Chase Travel could change my ticket as everything was sold out. Viator got creative and although we missed our tour group- we still got in and it was amazing! The Alhambra staff was also super helpful- lots of staff approaching tourists from all over the world and patiently answering questions. Well done, Alhambra
author: mariamC1027XZ

title: Alhambra explained by Jose
text: We booked with GetYourGuide and we ended up with Jose as our guide and he was absolutely amazing. He truly loves what he’s doing and my husband and I would’ve missed so much information had we tried to do it by ourselves. Jose works for Viaternum.
author: 781cynthiaj

title: Visit the Alhambra with someone prepared to explain it to you: you will appreciate it even more.
text: For the third time I visited the Alhambra, but never like this time did I get the information I was looking for. The guide, Antonio, was very knowledgeable but also expert in knowing how to keep the attention of those following him: a profound connoisseur of history and more.
